'''Imperial Garrison Three Forty-Three''' was a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was stationed next to the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. During a [[mission to Ziost]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] attempted to deceive the garrison into believing explosives had been set in [[Minister/Legends|Minister]] [[Davidge]]'s office that would endanger his life.<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>
